description: BFC 100 is announced: undefeated lightweight king Aslan Tamiev will defend his belt against the division's loudest challenger, Jordan 'Showtime' Cross, in the main event.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Twenty-one and oh? Saturday that becomes twenty-one and one.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You talk. I wrestle. We will see who is tired in round three.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Nobody's seen you hit. You haven't been hit. I hit.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then hit me. I will be there, in your face, all night.

action: Lies on his back on the mat, pressing his hips into Aliyev's shoulders in a positional grind.
thought: Every day, the mountain gets heavier.

action: Fires combinations on the heavy bag while a coach calls cadence, each punch crisp and fast.
Wraps his hands slowly, watching the young fighters from the corner with a veteran's eye.
Drills takedown setups against a heavy bag, each shot explosive and sharp.
Leads a grappling session with two younger fighters, pressing the pace, smothering them in position.
Rolls easy on a mat in the corner, a measuring stick watching the contenders.
thought: Been here before. Many times over.

action: Unloads bombs on a heavy bag, the swivel hips and explosiveness of a true banger.
Grinds with Tamiev on the mat, wrestling for position, every muscle tense and fighting.

description: Cross approaches Tamiev mid-drill as the announcement spreads—their title fight is official for Saturday, the mountain and the showman finally facing their moment.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Mountain. Saturday. Main event. That's MY belt up for grabs.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Not for grabs. It will be with me after.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: That's what every fighter says before they face me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_aliyev
dialogue.line: You're facing a wrestler. Not your usual dinner date.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Rustam, you got choked. Keep watching from the sideline.

dialogue.speaker: hw_walker
dialogue.line: Yo, both of you bring the NOISE on Saturday. That's the deal.

dialogue.speaker: fw_hale
dialogue.line: Respect. Respect to whoever is standing at the end.

dialogue.speaker: lw_torres
dialogue.line: Cross has the speed. Tamiev's got the grind. This is a real fight.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I'm ready. Every training day is the same.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: That's exactly the problem. You've never faced me before.

dialogue.speaker: lw_aliyev
dialogue.line: He's 21-0. What's your record, Jordan? Twenty and two?

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Twenty and two. I lost twice. Learned twice. You're undefeated but green.

dialogue.speaker: fw_karim
dialogue.line: Both of you are hungry. That's what I see.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Hungry doesn't matter. Wrestling matters. Control matters.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: And striking matters when you keep a man off his back.

dialogue.speaker: lw_torres
dialogue.line: Saturday will tell the truth. Always does.

action: Grinds through a takedown drill, rolling from his back with his partner across the mat.
thought: He talks. I work. Saturday decides.

action: Works the heavy bag with crisp combinations, celebrating the title-shot announcement with his team.
thought: My moment finally. Mountain's about to crumble.

action: Watches from the mat, observing the two title contenders with quiet, measured interest.
thought: Both dangerous. Showtime has the speed.

action: Continues his tidy distance drills on the heavy bag, striking with technical precision.
thought: Stay ready. Title contenders are focused.

action: Throws precise teeps and jabs on the heavy bag, working his karate-based distance game.
thought: Puzzles beat power. Distance beats chaos.

action: Walks forward methodically, throwing combinations while a coach calls cadence, unbothered by the main-event drama.
thought: Walk forward. Never stop. One pace.

action: Watches the champion and his challenger from the corner, then mirrors their intensity in his own work.
thought: That's the level. That's where I'm going.

action: Hits the heavy bag with his signature right-hand power, controlled and methodical, aware of the championship tension.
thought: Loud and quiet. Both ways to win.

description: Cross locks eyes with Tamiev as the Saturday announcement spreads—the undefeated Mountain and the Showtime challenger facing their moment at last, the gym electric with what's to come.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Tamiev! You see it? We're on for the strap Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I see it.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You finally got tested, Mountain. The real test starts now.

dialogue.speaker: lw_mori
dialogue.line: Showtime got his moment. The level awaits.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Come Saturday, you will understand why I remain undefeated.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Understand? The whole world's gonna see your weakness — my speed.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Fastest hands in this division. Your wrestling can't answer that.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Speed without patience is reckless. We will see which survives.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_ford
dialogue.line: That's your undefeated champ right there. That's the level.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Your level is broken ground, Mountain. I'm the earthquake.

dialogue.speaker: mw_hcosta
dialogue.line: Tamiev's patient. Cross has the volume. Both dangerous.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You will learn Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I'm gonna teach the whole world.

dialogue.speaker: hw_boateng
dialogue.line: One's loud. One's quiet. Quiet usually wins.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Not this time, Concrete. Not this time.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then we will make history together.

dialogue.speaker: lw_mori
dialogue.line: Two different paths. Same destination Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Yeah, and only one of us walks out champ.
